svg.title: A-103 Third Floor & Roof Plan
svg.text: Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm

Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. One two-bedroom apartment. The party wall can only be
opened between y 3.80 and 7.18 — north of that it backs
onto the stair, lobby and riser — so the living, dining
and kitchen run right across that band as one 10.60 m wide
room, and it is the only link between the two blocks.
2. The south terrace therefore sits on the 1.20 m cantilever,
the full width of the building, under a pergola. The north
terrace is in block B, shaded by the boundary wall and
carrying the plant behind a screen.
3. Bedroom 1 and its ensuite take block B with openable east
windows above +3.00. Bedroom 2 is in block A at the light
court. No room is entered through another: the family
bath, the WC, the store and bedroom 2 all open off the
4. Terrace finish is 30 mm below internal floor level,
falling 1:80 to outlets at the parapet. Parapets are 250
mm thick and 1.10 m high above the terrace finish.
5. The roof over this floor falls 1:60 to outlets at the
parapet, waterproofing turned up 150 mm minimum. The light
court is carried up through this floor and remains open to
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
